mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_call_log (request_id, model_alias, channel, stream, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, status, error_code, duration_ms, created_at) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{modelAlias}, #{channel}, #{stream}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{totalTokens}, #{status}, #{errorCode}, #{durationMs}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, request_id AS requestId, model_alias AS modelAlias, channel, stream, prompt_tokens AS promptTokens, completion_tokens AS completionTokens, total_tokens AS totalTokens, status, error_code AS errorCode, duration_ms AS durationMs, created_at AS createdAt FROM chat_call_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) AS successCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) AS failedCount FROM chat_call_log
